This link may have been intercepted.If you did not open it yourself, someone else may have. Treat the secret as compromised: ask the sender to change or revoke it, then send a new link over a different channel.
  • Chat or mail previewers can sometimes open links. Cinder never burns on preview, so a burn means a person (or script) pressed Reveal.
